choices.bothSub: Full evaluation on one report page

analyses.claSub: Gear, enchants, gems, consumables, drums, potions & shadow resistance
analyses.rpbSub: Avoidable damage, deaths, activity, cooldowns, interrupts & log checks

all.label: All
all.sub: Warcraft Logs detected by the bot in the log channel and reports evaluated from a link, newest post time first. Each report is evaluated only once.
all.empty: No logs yet. As soon as a Warcraft Logs link is posted in the log channel, it shows up here.

open.label: Open
open.sub: Logs that neither CLA nor RPB has run on. Check them first via the log link, then "Evaluate".
open.empty: No log is waiting for an evaluation.

unlinked.label: No raid event
unlinked.tip: Not assigned to a raid event
unlinked.sub: Each log belongs to the raid whose start time fits the post time. The suggestion is preselected in the assign dialog.
unlinked.empty: All logs are assigned to a raid event.

done.label: Evaluated
done.sub: Logs with a CLA or RPB evaluation and the reports created from a link.

confirm.resetText: The {label} evaluation of "{title}" is discarded and can be started again afterwards.
confirm.deleteLogText: "{title}" is removed from the list. An existing evaluation is kept as a report.
confirm.unlinkText: The assignment of "{title}" to "{event}" is removed. The evaluation itself stays.

columns.logSub: Title from Warcraft Logs, post time and channel. Sorted by the post time in the channel.
columns.contentSub: Which raids the log contains and how many bosses are down. Yellow: the final boss is missing, the raid may still be running.
columns.evaluationSub: CLA (gear, consumables, fight timeline) and RPB (damage, deaths, activity). Time, players and issues in the badge's tooltip.
columns.eventSub: The Raid-Helper event the log belongs to – the event whose start time fits the post time.

toolbar.autoMatchSub: Assigns each open log to the raid event whose start time clearly fits. Ambiguous ones are left for the assign dialog.
toolbar.scanSub: Searches the log channels for Warcraft Logs links the bot missed.
toolbar.noChannelsSub: Without a log channel the bot detects no logs on its own. Set it in the settings.

raids.zoneSub: The bosses of this log have not been read yet.
raids.unknownSub: Warcraft Logs has not delivered the fight list yet – it is requested again on the next load.

badges.runningSub: Progress in the notice at the bottom centre.
badges.noneSub: "Evaluate" runs CLA and RPB one after the other, both end up on one report page.

event.sub: {start}{source}. Change it via the row menu.
event.reportTip: Cannot be assigned without a log
event.reportSub: This report was created from a link. Only a log can be assigned – post the link in the log channel, then it shows up as a log.
event.noneSub: No raid event has a start time that fits this log's post time.
event.ambiguousSub: The start times are close together – please check.

row.evaluateBothSub: Both halves one after the other, one report page.

assign.title: Assign raid event
assign.hint: The assignment can be changed any time via the row menu.
assign.sortedHint: sorted by closeness to the post time – the first one is preselected
assign.none: No raid event with a fitting start time found.

newEval.kicker: Warcraft Logs report from a link
newEval.hint: Runs in the background – progress at the bottom centre.
newEval.linkTipSub: The link from Warcraft Logs or just the ID behind it. Logs detected by the bot are already in the list and can be evaluated there directly.
